scientific_integrity: A complete elementary fractional triangle-packing proof and finite independent checks are included. Computational tests are not treated as a proof for all parameters.
scientific_limitations: Exact value and uniqueness are proved for the stated range only. The value fails strictly below it, without an exact below-threshold formula. The boundary has at least r+1 optima, not a claimed complete census. Priority is provisional pending independent literature review.
title: Sharp split-graph threshold and uniqueness for two-token maximum cuts
